summary: All 12 plan tasks (TASK-1-1 through TASK-5-6) across 5 phases are fully implemented and verified. Phase 1: _render_phase_box signature changed from containers_count/agents_count to agents: list[AgentExecution], _get_agent_status_symbol helper added with correct mappings for all 4 statuses, aggregate count rendering replaced with per-agent role+status lines sorted by AgentRole enum order with 4+ agent line wrapping. Phase 2: render_pipeline_dag passes full agent list instead of integer counts. Phase 3: generate_status_report agents field returns list[dict] with role/status instead of integer count. Phase 4: render_phase_detail refactored to use shared _get_agent_status_symbol helper, eliminating duplicated mapping logic. Phase 5: All 6 test tasks implemented — test_phase_with_containers renamed to test_phase_with_agents with AgentExecution fixtures, mixed status test, no-agents test, ASCII mode test, status report format test updated, and _get_agent_status_symbol unit tests added. All 35 DAG visualizer tests pass. No orphaned code outside task scope. The diff includes commits from other issues (#605, #606, #607) but those do not affect 596 contract compliance.
